lines.text: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and planted a garden in Eden, in the east.
A river flowed out of Eden and branched into four headwaters, and the Pishon winds through Havilah, where gold is.
The LORD God placed the man in the Garden of Eden and forbade eating from the tree of life.

wrong_details.true: tree of the knowledge of good and evil

lines.text: The man named every beast of the field, but no suitable helper was found, so God took a rib.
God made a woman from the rib, and he said she shall be called woman, taken from the ground.
